notes_for_us: Two of the three things this user asked for are not layout - built-in music is audio, house lights are lighting - and the handoff has a home for neither. The record therefore looks like a preset-only build even though the prompt was specific.

'House lights' is a term with a precise meaning in venue work: the audience lighting, as opposed to the stage wash. Nothing in the skill can express which set of fixtures is meant, so it was drawn as one rig.
Entertainment's genre note about the crowd facing one way was the single most useful line in this batch - it is the reason social-hub is an audience floor here and not a plaza.
